questions.text: Consider a put option and a call option on the same stock with the same strike price of Rs 150 and time to maturity of three months. Select the correct statements
options: If the stock price at expiration is Rs 160, call option is out of the money.
If the stock price at expiration is Rs 160, put option is out of the money.
If the stock price at expiration is Rs 140, call option is in the money.
If the stock price at expiration is Rs 140, put option is in the money.
correct_answer: If the stock price at expiration is Rs 160, put option is out of the money.
If the stock price at expiration is Rs 140, put option is in the money.

questions.text: Security A has an expected return of 12% and a standard deviation of 10%. Security B has an expected return of 18% and a standard deviation of 20%. Suppose that the rates of return of the two securities have a correlation coefficient of 0.6. Based on the given information select the correct statements from below.
options: The covariance of security A and security B is 1.2%.
If an investor invests 50% of wealth in each security, then his portfolio’s expected return is 15%.
If an investor invests 50% of wealth in each security, then his portfolio’s standard deviation is 13.60%.
If short selling is not allowed, it is not possible to build a portfolio with expected return of 20%.
correct_answer: The covariance of security A and security B is 1.2%.
If an investor invests 50% of wealth in each security, then his portfolio’s expected return is 15%.
If an investor invests 50% of wealth in each security, then his portfolio’s standard deviation is 13.60%.
If short selling is not allowed, it is not possible to build a portfolio with expected return of 20%.

questions.text: A money manager calculates that JLK Inc stock has an expected rate of return of 14%. JLK Inc has a beta of 1.5. The risk-free rate of return is 6%, and the expected market rate of return is 12%. Which of the following statements are correct?
options: JLK stock would lie above the security market line.
JLK stock would lie below the security market line.
correct_answer: JLK stock is overpriced.
JLK stock would lie below the security market line.

questions.text: A stock is trading at Rs 50 today. In 6 months, the stock price can either increase to Rs 60 or decrease to Rs 45. The six-month risk-free rate is 2%. A six-month call option has an exercise price of Rs 55. Select the correct statements based on the given information.
options: The risk-neutral probability that stock price increases is 40%.
The hedge ratio for the given call option is 1/3.
The purchase of one share can be hedged with 3 call options.
According to risk-neutral approach, the price of call option is Rs 7.84.
correct_answer: The risk-neutral probability that stock price increases is 40%.
The hedge ratio for the given call option is 1/3.
The purchase of one share can be hedged with 3 call options.
